name: ckb
description: Turn one or more repositories, plus their architecture docs, diagrams, cloud IaC (Terraform, AWS, Azure, GCP) and CSPM results, into a cited knowledge base (HLD/LLD, cross-repo flows, outputs and conditions, documented-vs-observed drift), a STRIDE threat model, scanner-ready context.md files, and a static supply-chain and prompt-injection audit with optional OSV/Snyk advisory lookups. Read-only on targets.
